speech_20260811_163841.mp3.title: Granite and Echo The mountain holds its breath…
speech_20260811_163841.mp3.text:
Granite and Echo

The mountain holds its breath against the cold,
A monolith of slate and quiet stone,
Where stories of the ancient earth are told
In languages of frost and wind alone.

Above the timberline, the shadows shift,
The blue hour hangs suspended in the air,
While through the pass the quiet currents drift,
Unconcerned with what is fleeting there.

A sudden spark of daylight cuts the crest,
Illuminating ridges silver-lined,
And in that silent, towering arrest,
The noise of lower worlds is left behind.

speech_20260811_164634.mp3.title: नया सवेरा रात के गहरे अँधेरे को चीरकर…
speech_20260811_164634.mp3.text:
नया सवेरा

रात के गहरे अँधेरे को चीरकर,
एक किरण फिर मुस्कुराई है।
सोई हुई इस ख़ामोशी में,
उम्मीद की नई आहट आई है।

जो रास्ते कल तक धुंध से ढके थे,
उनपर अब धूप निखरने लगी।
मुझसे उलझती हवाएँ भी अब,
एक मीठा साज़ बनकर बिखरने लगी।

ना रुकना है, ना झुकना है मुझे,
चाहे राहें कितनी भी अनजानी हों।
हर कदम पर एक नया हौसला है,
हर मोड़ पर नई कहानी हो।

उठो कि सूरज तुम्हें पुकार रहा,
आसमां भी ज़मीन पर झुकने आया है।
आज फिर एक छोटे से दीये ने,
अँधेरे को हराने का संकल्प उठाया है।

speech_20260811_192559.mp3.title: But here's how you get to keep your…
speech_20260811_192559.mp3.text:
But here's how you get to keep your number. Sell lifetime at $57.77 as a launch offer, capped at the first 500 buyers or the first six months, then it goes to $147.77 permanently. Early believers get a genuine bargain, you get a cash injection exactly when you need it for marketing, urgency does real work in your launch copy, and you haven't capped your pricing forever. Say the cap out loud and then honour it.

Three other things:

Define what lifetime means before you sell one. Lifetime of the product, not of the customer, and be explicit about whether major versions are included. If v4 is a paid upgrade, say so on the checkout page. Sketch nearly burned its community getting this wrong.

You've lost your ceiling. With $57.77 as the top price, a full-time creator monetising covers on YouTube is worth exactly the same to you as someone who tries it twice. Those are the people most able and willing to pay. Add a commercial tier at $17.77/month or $177.77/year carrying commercial-use terms, multi-machine activation and priority support. One extra tier, and it will likely be a meaningful slice of revenue.
